notes.title: Faulty Apprentice v.1.0.12 patch notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/de19d3a1852e428402ac2d212d69cc4504d66d29.png
Hail Apprentices! We know you're all busy with War Preparations, but the Royal Commander wishes to relay some new information.

Main additions / changes:
 Black Screen at start of the game: We believe is possibly caused by some old GPU's that have hard time loading the game. This issue should now be fixed, but if it happens again, please let us know.

 Skip function is now available! This enables you to skip dialogue until an important story choice comes up. It could also be adjusted in the Setting section. (Located at the bottom left of the screen.) 

 Now along with left-click, you could also proceed with the story dialogue using the spacebar! We know, this is pretty expected for VN's, so we apologize for not getting it in sooner!

 Fire is with or against you! The Cinder Guard previously had fewer dialogue opportunities than other Guards, so we've added a couple more! But be warned, if you thought it was hard to Talk to her before... Well, you'll see.

 CLIMAX!!! We've updated a pivotal choice during the final battle. Players complained that it was a forced choice so we made it more interactive with additional consequences to help the story flow closer to how we envisioned it. 

 Gallery! Bug saying "Click to interact" with non-interactable images in gallery has been fixed!

 Missing Achievements are now fixed!

 Typos and other small tweaks!


Thanks to all the Apprentices that gave us feedback! While we may not be able to accommodate every request as a small (two guys, one gal) studio, we certainly listen to every request. If you haven't left a review yet, please do. (It give Stars Reach Castle POWER!!) 

Faulty Apprentice contains more secrets than the Dark Elf prisoner, so don't be shy joining our discord seeking aide from your fellow Apprentices! On the other side of the battlefield, if you've already completed the goals of your apprenticeship, please join to help out new apprentices!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/4ebf9ef7663187baf8c8b65592cc0135fbfde0c2.png
AGL Discord: https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt

Thank you for playing Faulty Apprentice! 
Din + AGL Team

notes.title: Faulty Apprentice One-Month before Release!
notes.notes:
Greeting Apprentices! We have some good news and bad news to share... The Faulty Apprentice release is only four weeks away!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/fdee4105e04a15eb458812732a46daf402c87664.jpg

The bad news though, is Faulty Apprentice release is four weeks away XD But don't worry, we've got some ideas to help that four-week wait go by as quick as possible!


 Tell your favorite Streamer/YouTuber to make a playthrough of Faulty Apprentice! If they can contact us, we may even be able to give them an early copy of the game!

 Show Faulty Apprentice to a friend! Chatting with your friends is a fun way to pass time, but more importantly, you need to let them know which FA girl is your waifu so they don't get any ideas!

 Get creative by drawing some fan art or writing a short poem for the Goth Guard! If you share it with us, you just might see it featured in-game! (=

 Join the adventure... AGAIN! We will be sharing the Map to Adventure quest from the final days of our Kickstarter Campaign with the public. Follow us on Twitter to join the fun and help make decisions on where to go and what to do!



We remind you once again to join our Discord community! Meet other Faulty Apprentice developers (We don't bite!) and friendly fans! [ here ]

Comment below and let us know what you're looking forward to most in the final game and hit that Like button if you're hyped!

Din + Faulty Apprentice team

notes.title: Faulty Apprentice Release Date!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34244145/ed16e713a0e2700ee7fcc7fcd45b991692b6d58e.jpg

It has been a long road rebuilding Faulty Apprentice from scratch in Unity Engine, but we are incredibly proud of what our humble game has become. Not only have we completed ALL of our Stretch Goal in-game content from out initial Kickstarter Campaign, but with the help of our Patreon Supporters we've added even MORE! What more, you ask? Customizable features such as Banners and Titles, partial Voice Acting for the Guards, new Locations, Master Equipment sets, and even a few Secret Scenes (= 

As a special thank you to everyone that supported Faulty Apprentice on Kickstarter and preordered on BackerKit, we will be releasing Chapter 2 in a couple of weeks as well as a beta version of the full game when we are closer to release. If you are not a Patron supporter and wish to play chapter 2, you must preorder before August 8, 2019  
Join our patreon to play Chapter 2 and more now! 

Patreon Supporters with lifetime pledge of $20 or more will receive a download code for full game at time of release!

We are excited to share our hard work with you all, and hope you are excited, too! Please look forward to more updates and once again, thank you for supporting Faulty Apprentice!

Comment what you're looking forward to the most in the final game and hit that Like button if you're hyped!


 Faulty Apprentice will be released November 12, 2019


 Lock date for Preorders November 10, 2019 https://faultyapprentice.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders
